title: Racing to Memphis for New Year's Eve at the Casino Ballroom
summary: After a hotel job in Oklahoma City, the band drives all night, breaks down at Cabot, and reaches Memphis after midnight.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Oklahoma City we played about Oklahoma City until the latter part of the year, the next to the last day in the year we had a big job to play at one of the big hotels there in Oklahoma City and we played this job and we were booked the following night, which was New Year's evenight in Memphis, Tennessee. We were booked at the Casino Ballroom. We played this job, this night, and we finished, we got our money, we got in our cars and we left for Memphis, Tennessee. We drove all night. We went through all across Arkansas, and we got -- when we got to Cabot, Arkansas, our car broke down. So we called Memphis to tell them we was on our way, we finally got it fixed and the roads back in those days you didn't have good highways, It was root pig or

die poor hog. So we got there fighting that rough road, trying to make it to Memphis on this New Year's eve night. We finally got to Memphis, but it was after 12:00 o'clock. And the people who owned the ballroom had to refund money back to those who wanted to leave. But that was a fair crowd there when we got there, and we were able to play a few tunes, but you can imagine a place of business on a New Year's eve night, which is supposed to be the getaway night of the year, not being able to follow through with their program of having a band and being able to make up some of the losses they had incurred during the past year.
